* Your order number (you can find this on your receipt or in your email confirmation)
* A photo of the damaged book
* A brief explanation of the issue

Once we receive your email, we'll guide you through the return process and provide you with a return shipping label. Please note that you don't need to send the damaged book back to us.

If you have any further questions or concerns, feel free to ask, and I'll be happy to help.

replies:
Hello there!

I'd be happy to help clarify the benefits of our premium membership tier, Bramble Club. As a Standard member, you're eligible for 10% off every book (excluding gift cards) and free standard shipping on every US order, with no minimum.

However, to access the exclusive offers mentioned on our homepage, you'll need to upgrade to the Bramble Club membership tier. As a Bramble Club member, you'll get:

* 10% off every book (including gift cards)
* Free standard shipping on every US order, with no minimum
* Early access to signed editions
* And, of course, the benefits of being a Standard member

The Bramble Club membership costs $29 a year, and you can cancel any time from your account page. If you cancel within 14 days of joining and haven't used the discount, we'll refund the full fee. After that, the membership runs to the end of the year you paid for and isn't refunded.

If you're interested in upgrading to Bramble Club, I can help you with that. Alternatively, if you have any questions about the benefits or would like more information, feel free to ask!
